summary: Expand Energy Corporation filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, reporting completion of a previously announced underwritten public offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 5.650% Senior Notes due 2031. The notes were issued under a base indenture with Regions Bank as trustee, as supplemented by a second supplemental indenture, and registered under an automatically effective Form S-3 shelf. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, rank pari passu with existing senior debt, are structurally subordinated to subsidiary debt, and carry customary lien and merger covenants plus a par call date of August 15, 2031.
